name: usage-pill
description: A usage bar above the prompt: task progress, session and weekly limits, context tokens, warm or cold prompt cache

notifyOnDone.title: Notify when Claude finishes
notifyOnDone.description: Raise a notification when a long turn ends and you are not looking at the session

notifyAfterMinutes.title: Notify after (minutes)
notifyAfterMinutes.description: Only turns at least this long raise the finished notification

headroomAt.title: Context headroom row from (%)
headroomAt.description: When the context is at least this full, a second row under the bar shows what fills it, what the last turn added, and a Compact now button
